results.name: The same ROM-independent record method runs in a fresh Forge project
No edits reproduce arbitrary source bytes, including unknown bytes and flags
A masked edit changes only its declared bits and preserves unrelated records
Editing independent masks in one byte retains both fields
Read-only flag edits and undeclared fields are refused
Duplicate edits, extra properties and record overflow are refused
Noninteger and out-of-range values cannot be coerced into native bytes
Overlapping masks across fields or records are refused before encoding
Malformed layouts, unaligned masks and source overflow are refused
Native metadata requires schema 13 and original source bytes
Older projects migrate without enabling the native backend
Native source recognition refuses unknown engines and modified protected data
